question: What characterizes a person who becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture?
premises: The person is a seeker driven by greed.
The person is described as fickle and constant in that fickleness.
Such a person is called a mockery of the Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of capalā in this compressed verse is somewhat ambiguous.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
